stops.note: named for the wooden spear-throwing device
the Aztecs used the spear-thrower against Spanish armour; Zelia Nuttall's 1891 study of the Mexican atlatl fixed the Nahuatl name in archaeology
stops.meaning: a hand-held device for throwing darts or spears with greater force

current_meaning: an ancient hand-held tool used to launch spears or darts with increased leverage and speed
